title: Nontuberculous mycobacteria as a Wikipedia remainder class
dek: Everything in Mycobacterium that is not MTBC and not M. leprae, in the usual teaching cut. Speciation and MAC therapy stay on tb-ntm.
story: Nontuberculous mycobacteria on Wikipedia are the remainder class: mycobacteria that are not MTBC and not leprosy bacilli. Older names (MOTT, atypical) still pollute search.

Simplfy's tb-ntm plate is how a TB lab avoids reporting MAC as pan-susceptible TB. This card is the encyclopedia remainder so related[] can hold both the class and celebrity species (MAC, kansasii, abscessus).
Environmental reservoirs and opportunistic lung disease in bronchiectasis/COPD are the Wikipedia epidemiology. They are not a reason to skip a TB work-up when the syndrome is TB-like.
deep: Rapid versus slow grower is a Runyon-ish teaching split still on encyclopedia pages; WGS names species better.
ATS/IDSA NTM treatment is not WHO TB Groups. Do not BPaLM a kansasii without looking.
False MTBC NAAT is uncommon but mis-speciated MGIT bottles are not.
M. leprae is not NTM in this teaching cut — own node.
